title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-010
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of an FAA interview with a JAL flight engineer regarding a UFO sighting in 1986.

incidents.summary: JAL flight engineer Yoshie Tsukuba reports sighting unidentified lights while in flight, observed visually and on radar.
incidents.quote: The first time I saw it was through the Ll window, at the 11 o'clock position.
